newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen mixed, consolidation likely.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen mixed, consolidation likely.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be mixed on Monday on possible profit-taking after the index rose about four percent last week, brokers said.
They added however that counters which have recently announced sound first quarter results such as Lippo Securities, Lippo Life and blue chip Bank Negara Indonesia could continue to attract buyers.
Cocoa butter producer Cahaya Kalbar and property firm Elang Realty could also attract market attention on their corporate plans, brokers said.
Small-cap cocoa grinding firm Cahaya Kalbar rose 25 rupiah to 2,850 rupiah following market talk of a possible rights issue to acquire a trading firm, brokers said.
Another small-cap property firm Elang Realty rose 50 rupiah to 1,725 rupiah in active trading as the firm got shareholder approval on Friday to prepare a rights issue plan.

Selamat Sampurna also rose 100 rupiah to 1,600 rupiah, albeit in small trading volume, due to news reports that the firm had signed an agreement to supply automobile parts to Bakrie Motor, brokers said.

Big-cap Bank International Indonesia rose 50 rupiah to 1,925 rupiah following foreign-led buying, brokers said, adding it could reach at least 2,000 rupiah in the near term due to expected sustained foreign interest.
Brokers, however, said prices were likely to move in a narrow range for the rest of the day, with foreign players seen taking profit in big-caps.
